pipeline_stage: Stage 8 pilot synthesis (5 papers, simulated extraction)

excluded_row_details.reason: wheat straw yield — not primary harvestable product; adjudication excluded

flagged_row_details.reason: 26.5% effect — cumulative soil priming plausible but exceeds typical single-season range; included in sensitivity analysis
34.3% effect under drought stress — partially aligned estimand; included in stress subgroup only

primary_synthesis.method: unweighted_mean_lnRR (pilot estimate; n too small for robust DL-RE)
primary_synthesis.note: CIs estimated as pooled_lnRR ± 1.96 * SD_of_individual_lnRRs / sqrt(n); pilot estimate only

inverse_variance_weighted_estimate.method: simplified IV weighting using (SE/control_mean)^2 as variance proxy
inverse_variance_weighted_estimate.note: IV weights favour low-SE rows (P01 maize/wheat with large sample sizes); higher precision estimate than unweighted; pilot approximation only

dslaird_re_estimate.note: Substantial heterogeneity (I²=67%); expected at this corpus stage; reflects crop diversity and stress conditions; DL-RE is the appropriate model

benchmark_comparison.assessment: Pilot estimate of +10.9% (unweighted) to +11.5% (DL-RE) is consistent with benchmark +12%. Benchmark falls within pilot 95% CI (7.2-14.6%). Gap of -1.1 to -0.5 percentage points is within noise for a 5-paper pilot. Direction is confirmed positive.

field_only.note: All extracted rows are field experiments; no greenhouse rows in pilot; cannot compute field vs greenhouse contrast yet

by_ha_source.note: Leonardite shows larger effect; could reflect higher rate (4 t/ha) or leonardite-specific mechanisms; small n precludes inference

stress_condition_rows.note: Drought and P-deficiency stress rows (flagged as partially_aligned); much larger than standard conditions; consistent with HA stress-amelioration literature

excluding_flagged_rows.note: Removing the two flagged high-effect rows reduces estimate slightly; still directionally consistent
